message.content: I've reviewed the artifact (problem contract and full kernel source are already loaded). The kernel implements softplus as `max(x,0) + log(1+exp(-|x|))`, where `log(s)` is computed by range reduction around √2: `log(s) = ln(√2) + 2·atanh(q)`, `q=(s−√2)/(s+√2)`, with the atanh odd series truncated after the q⁵ term (Horner gives `1 + q²/3 + q⁴/5`). That truncation is the main correctness surface: at the endpoints of s∈[1,2], |q| reaches 0.171573, and the dropped terms sum to roughly `2·(q⁷/7 + q⁹/9 + …) ≈ 1.3e-6`, which exceeds the contract's fixed 1e-6 absolute tolerance (attained near x≈0 / s≈2 and where s rounds to 1, i.e., |x| ≳ 16.6). I'll record this description model now.

message.reasoning_content:
Analyze the kernel math. The kernel computes softplus via log(s) approximated by atanh-style range reduction. The polynomial looks off: log(s) via atanh expansion: log(s) = 2*atanh((s-1)/(s+1)). Here reduced around sqrt(2): q = (s-sqrt2)/(s+sqrt2). log(s) = log(sqrt2) + 2*(q + q^3/3 + q^5/5 + ...). Constant 0.34657 = ln 2/2. Correction = ln(√2)... wait 0.34657359 = ln(2)/2 = ln(√2)? ln(√2)=0.34657. Yes. So value = max(x,0) + ln(√2) + 2q*(1 + q²/3 + ...). The polynomial: starts 0.2 (q^5 coefficient? 1/5=0.2), then +q²*0.2 into 1/3 → 0.333+0.2q², then 1.0 + q²*(that) = 1 + q²/3 + q²/5 q²... wait Horner: p = 0.2; p = 1/3 + q²*p = 1/3 + 0.2 q²; p = 1 + q²*p = 1 + q²/3 + 0.2 q⁴. So terms: 1 + q²/3 + q⁴/5 — truncates at q⁵ effectively. Series for atanh: q + q³/3 + q⁵/5 + q⁷/7... So missing q⁷/7, q⁹/9 terms. Truncation error ~2*q⁷/7. q = (s-√2)/(s+√2). s = 1+exp(-|x|), range [1,2]. At s=1 (x=±∞ large |x|), q = (1-1.4142)/(1+1.4142) = -0.1716. q⁷ ≈ -5e-7; 2*q⁷/7 ≈ -1.4e-7... fine. At s=2 (x=0), q=(2-1.4142)/(3.4142)=0.1716. Same magnitude. So truncation error ~1.5e-7, under 1e-6. Hmm but also for large |x|, correction→ln(√2)? Wait when s→1, q→-0.1716, correction→0.34657+2*(-0.1716)*(≈1.0098) ≈ 0.34657-0.3466... Actually log(s) at s=1 is 0. So math is self-consistent: log(s) = ln√2 + 2*atanh(q) where q=(s-√2)/(s+√2). Check: 0.5 ln(s) = ... identity: ln(s) = ln(√2) + 2 atanh((s-√2)/(s+√2))? Verify: let t=atanh((s-a)/(s+a)) with a=√2. atanh(z) = 0.5 ln((1+z)/(1-z)). (1+z)/(1-z) = (s+a+s-a)/(s+a-s+a) = 2s/(2a) = s/a. So 2 atanh = ln(s/a) = ln s - ln a. So log(s) = ln a + 2 atanh(q). ✓. So kernel = max(x,0) + ln(1+e^{-|x|}) which equals softplus. Looks correct mathematically.

But wait — there's a subtle bug: the FP16 clamped at ±65504 → softplus(65504) = 65504 + ~0; correction ~ 0.34657 - small. Actually at x=65504, exp(-x) in FP32 underflows to 0, s=1, q=-0.1716, correction = 0.34657 - 0.3466? Let me compute: 2q*(1+q²/3+q⁴/5). q=-0.17157. q²=0.029437. p = 0.2; 0.3333+0.005887=0.33922; 1+0.029437*0.33922=1.00998. 2q*p = -0.34314*1.00998 = -0.34657. correction = 0.34657-0.34657 = ~0 (small residual + truncation error ~2*q⁷/7≈+1.5e-7? sign: atanh truncated misses +q⁷/7+q⁹/9... with q negative missing terms negative → atanh overestimated → correction too large? error ≈ -2*(q⁷/7+...) ≈ +1.5e-7 positive... anyway small). So value ≈ 65504.0000 ± 1.5e-7 ≤ 1e-6 tolerance ✓.

For negative x, exp(-|x|) → 1 when |x| large, s=2, q=0.17157: correction = 0.34657+0.34314*1.00998 = 0.34657+0.34657=0.6931 = ln 2 ✓ plus truncation ~ -1.5e-7. Then softplus(-large)= ln2 ≈ 0.69315 vs true ~0. Tolerance 1e-6 fine.

FP32 rounding: tl.exp — error maybe 1 ulp; div_rn exact-rounded division. Overall error likely under 1e-6? Max |log| value here ~0.693; FP32 ulp 6e-8. Truncation dominates ~2*q⁷/7 = 2*5.1e-7/7 ≈ 1.46e-7? Wait q⁷ with q=0.1716: 0.1716⁷ ≈ 1.7e-6? 0.1716²=0.02944, ⁴=8.67e-4, ⁶=2.55e-5, ⁷=4.38e-6. 2*4.38e-6/7 = 1.25e-6 > 1e-6! Hmm, but also q⁹/9 terms subtract further; sum of missing terms = 2*Σ_{k≥7,odd} q^k/k = 2*(atanh(q) - q - q³/3 - q⁵/5) with q⁵/5 included via 0.2*q⁴*... wait polynomial includes 1 + q²/3 + q⁴/5, so terms q + q³/3 + q⁵/5 included. Missing: q⁷/7 + q⁹/9 + ... At q=0.1716: q⁷=4.38e-6 → /7=6.25e-7; q⁹=1.29e-7/9=1.4e-8. Sum ≈6.4e-7, ×2 = 1.28e-6 > 1e-6 tolerance! But wait — do both endpoints occur? q ranges over [-0.1716, +0.1716] only at s=1 or 2 exactly. But s=1 requires exp(-|x|)=0, i.e., |x| large. But then value = max(x,0)+correction where correction ≈ log(s) ≈ 0 for x>0 — but truncation error still 1.28e-6! Hmm, but actually for large |x| the exp underflows to exactly 0 in FP32, s=1 exactly, q = 0/2.414 = ... (1-1.41421)/(1+1.41421) computed in FP32: s-1.41421 = 1-1.41421 = -0.41421; sum = 2.41421; q ≈ -0.17157. error in log(s)=0 computed as 2*atanh(q) ≈ +1.28e-6? Sign: atanh(q) with negative q, missing terms q⁷/7 negative → computed atanh larger (less negative) → correction larger → value = x + ~1.28e-6 error. That exceeds 1e-6! Hmm wait, sign: truncated series omits q⁷/7+... For q<0 those are negative, so truncated sum > true atanh → computed log(s) > 0 ≈ +1.28e-6. But actual target log(1+e^{-x}) ≈ e^{-x} ≈ 0 for large x. So error ~+1.3e-6 > 1e-6 tolerance.

But wait, at x large, does exp underflow to exactly 0? exp(-65504) in FP32 = 0 yes, but even x=20: exp(-20)=2e-9, s=1+2e-9 = 1 (rounded, FP32 ulp at 1 is 1.19e-7, so 2e-9 rounds to 1.0). s=1 exactly, q=-0.17157. True log(1+2e-9) ≈ 2e-9, computed +1.28e-6. Error 1.28e-6 > 1e-6. For which x does exp(-|x|) > ulp/2 ≈ 6e-8, i.e., |x| < ~16.6? For |x| < 16.6, s > 1, q > -0.1716 magnitude slightly smaller but near. Actually the truncation error is largest at s=1 or s=2 (|q| max 0.1716). At s=2 (x=0? no — s=2 when exp=1, i.e., x=0): softplus(0)=ln2=0.69315. Truncation error +1.28e-6 in correction; value = max(0,0)+0.6931+1.28e-6 → error +1.28e-6 > 1e-6! So at x=0 (signed zeros legal!) error exceeds tolerance. Hmm, but wait—let me recheck coefficient q⁷. q at x=0: s = 1+exp(0)=2. q = (2-1.41421356)/(2+1.41421356) = 0.5857864/3.4142136 = 0.171572875. q⁷: ln q = ln 0.171573 = -1.76275. ×7 = -12.339. e^-12.339 = 4.38e-6. /7 = 6.26e-7. ×2 = 1.25e-6. Plus q⁹/9 = 1.43e-8. So truncation error ≈ 1.27e-6 > 1e-6. This looks like an intentional planted bug: too-short polynomial. But also FP32 rounding of the constant 0.34657359027997265 (ln√2 = 0.34657359027997264... exact). Anyway the dominant issue: truncation error ~1.3e-6 near x≈0 (and large |x|), exceeding 1e-6 absolute tolerance.

Also check: maybe I mis-derived; maybe the constant is ln(√2) but the formula intended log(s) = ln(a) + 2 atanh(q) — yes. So error E = 2*(q⁷/7 + q⁹/9 + ...). This is the key risk. Record description update with risk map noting this.

Also second concern: FP32 arithmetic rounding in Horner adds ~few ulps, small. Also tl.exp correctness. Also signed zero: -0.0 → exp(-0)=1, s=2, fine; max(-0,0)=0. OK.
